items.name: Roxanne_Ardary/chameleonai
items.description:
ChameleonAI is an open-source, hardware-agnostic AI inference optimization platform designed to deliver maximum performance, energy efficiency, and adaptability across any AI hardware, including Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Huawei, Apple, and emerging accelerators.

It features self-learning optimizations, predictive scheduling, mixed-precision tuning, and security-aware execution, ensuring models run faster, smarter, and safer. ChameleonAI supports cloud, edge, and embedded deployments, with developer-friendly profiling, benchmarking, and plugin tools for full control and transparency.  https://roxanneardary.com/chameleonai/
